title: Gradient descent on a curve
summary: Watch a weight move downhill and inspect each gradient descent step.

formula.latex: L(w) = \frac{1}{2}(w-2)^2, \quad g = w-2, \quad w' = w-\eta g

symbols.meaning: Loss: the height of the curve that we want to reduce.
Weight: the current position; w′ is the next position.
Gradient: the slope of the loss curve at the current weight.
Learning rate: how strongly the gradient changes the weight.

The gradient is {{gradient[0]}}. Using the learning rate {{rate}}, the next weight is approximately {{nextWeights[0]}}.
